title: Snow globe with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glass' cx='0.4' cy='0.35' r='0.7'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bfe9ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5b9bd5' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='27' ry='7' fill='#c98a3c'/>
  <rect x='23' y='78' width='54' height='8' rx='3' fill='#e0a04a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='27' ry='7' fill='#f0b968'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='21' ry='4.5' fill='#a86e2c'/>
  <!-- globe glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='32' fill='#8fd3ff' opacity='0.28'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#bfe9ff' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- snow inside -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='30' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='33' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='22' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='1.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='58' r='2.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='68' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='20' r='1.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='73' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snow mound -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='26' ry='9' fill='#eaf7ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smiling face in the snow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='17' fill='#f7fbff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#cfe8ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='56' r='2.6' fill='#3a6ea8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='56' r='2.6' fill='#3a6ea8'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='2.4' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='62' r='2.4' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 65 Q50 73 58 65' fill='none' stroke='#3a6ea8' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little carrot nose -->
  <path d='M50 60 L46 62 L50 64 Z' fill='#ff8c42'/>
</svg>
